units.source_text: 从鞍马道通往寺庙，一路上家家户户扎上松枝，屋顶洒上水。

en.t: Along the road from Kurama Road to the temple, every household had tied up pine branches, and water was sprinkled over the roofs.

units.source_text: 人们从半夜里就举着大大小小各式各样的火把，嘴里喊着“嗨哟嗨哟哟”的呼号，登上鞍马寺。

en.t: From midnight on, people climbed up to Kurama Temple carrying torches of every size and kind, shouting the chant, “Haiyo, haiyoyo.”

units.source_text: 两座轿子出现时，村里（现在是镇）的女人们全体出动去拉轿上的绳子。

en.t: When the two palanquins appeared, all the women of the village, now a town, came out together to pull the ropes attached to them.
Only at the end was the great torch offered.

units.source_text: 节日的活动一直持续到天快亮的时分。

en.t: The festival events continued until daybreak was near.
